🚨 Hiring Alert | 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝗹𝘆𝘀𝘁 /𝗦𝗲𝗻𝗶𝗼𝗿 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝗹𝘆𝘀𝘁 at YesMadam 🚨

We’re excited to share an opportunity for the role of Product Analyst/ Senior Product Analyst at YesMadam! If you enjoy solving business problems through data and thrive in a fast-paced B2C environment, this could be a great fit for you.

📍 Location: Noida (Work From Office – 5.5 days)
👥 Team: Product
💼 Experience: 3+ years (B2C experience mandatory)

💡 About YesMadam:
One of India’s fastest-growing salon-at-home platforms, delivering premium beauty and wellness services to millions of customers. As we scale, we’re strengthening our product and tech teams to enhance customer experience and drive growth.

🎯 Role Overview:
We’re looking for a data-driven professional who can turn complex data into actionable insights and influence key product decisions while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

📊 Key Responsibilities:
• Perform deep-dive analysis on product features to identify improvement opportunities
• Own and manage product dashboards and KPIs across user journeys
• Design, execute, and evaluate A/B tests with statistical rigor
• Track product releases and monitor post-launch performance
• Build dashboards using SQL, Python, and Tableau/Power BI
• Collaborate with Product Managers on roadmap decisions
• Work with Ops, Marketing & CX to improve conversion, retention, NPS & frequency
• Communicate insights effectively to technical and business stakeholders

🔍 What We’re Looking For:

Must-Have:
• 3+ years in product analytics (B2C required)
• Strong SQL, Python, and BI tools expertise (Tableau)
• Hands-on A/B testing experience
• Strong analytical thinking (funnels, cohorts, segmentation)
• Excellent communication & stakeholder management
• Ability to take ownership and work independently

Good to Have:
• Experience with Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA, BigQuery, Metabase
• Exposure to high-growth startup environments

✨ Why Join Us?
• High-impact role with strong visibility
• Work on a product used by millions across India
• Direct exposure to senior leadership
• Fast-paced, ownership-driven environment

📩 Interested candidates please apply directly or apply here : https://lnkd.in/dWS-679x
or drop your CV at Jobs@yesmadam.com.
